words.translation: 政府, 内阁; [经] 政府, 政治, 政体
synonyms_distinction: administration: 侧重指行政部门，强调日常管理工作
authority: 强调权力机构，侧重权威
state: 指国家政府，更正式
regime: 指政权制度，有时含贬义
governance: 指治理行为，更抽象
words.collins_definition: The government of a country is the group of people who are responsible for governing it.
examples: The government has announced new economic policies.
She works for the federal government.
The government will decide on the issue next week.

words.translation: 系统, 体系, 制度, 方式, 秩序, 分类原则; [计] 系统; 体制; 体系
synonyms_distinction: method: 指有系统的方法，侧重步骤
structure: 结构，侧重组织架构
framework: 框架，侧重基本结构
words.collins_definition: A system is a way of working, organizing, or doing something which follows a fixed plan or set of rules.
examples: The new system works efficiently.
We need a better system for organizing our work.
The education system needs reform.

words.translation: 力量, 权力; 可能, 也许
synonyms_distinction: may: 可能性稍大，更正式
could: 语气更委婉，可能性较小
words.collins_definition: You use might to indicate that something will possibly happen or be true in the future, but you are not certain.
examples: It might rain later.
She might come to the party.
He tried with all his might.

words.translation: 部分, 局部, 零件, 要素, 等分, 职责, 角色, 部位; 分开, 分离, 断绝, 区别, 分配; 分开, 断裂, 分手; 部分的, 局部的; 部分地, 有些
synonyms_distinction: section: 指整体的划分的一部分
words.collins_definition: A part of something is one of the pieces, sections, or pieces that it consists of.
examples: That's the best part of the book.
She played an important part in the project.
Part of the problem is lack of communication.

words.translation: 然而, 无论如何, 究竟怎样; 然而, 可是
words.collins_definition: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.
examples: The plan was good; however, it was too expensive.
She is very talented; however, she is lazy.
However hard he tried, he couldn't succeed.

words.translation: 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地; [计] 区域
synonyms_distinction: region: 较大的区域，有地理特征的
words.collins_definition: An area is a particular part of a town, country, region, or world.
examples: This is a residential area.
The area has a lot of parks.
She specializes in the area of finance.

words.translation: 反对, 对着, 倚靠
words.collins_definition: If one thing is leaning or presses against another, it is touching it or pressing it.
examples: He leaned against the wall.
They voted against the proposal.
The rain beat against the window.
